form.title: Start action and collect private fields
form.inspect: A write opens a fresh conversation. fields are values; selections are opaque bound references.

form.title: Validate session and refresh ownership
form.inspect: Origin/CSRF and cookie are checked. Local-customer account/card refreshes happen before the Agent request; each refresh has its own trace.

form.title: Accept and run private input operation
form.inspect: Inspect cid, operation id, request key, stored trace and worker lock. Both sync and async submissions use the journal.

form.title: Resolve values and prepare review
form.inspect: Inspect proposal, draft, private bindings and fresh review nonce. No write is authorized by form submission alone.

confirm.title: Send reviewed confirmation
confirm.inspect: Body contains the current review nonce. Browser operation key differs from the downstream execution key.

confirm.title: Validate nonce and persist exact submission
confirm.inspect: The execution snapshot and key are durable before the first write. Restricted card actions also recheck current facts and policy.

transport.title: Open authenticated MCP call
transport.inspect: Fresh destination token and customer assertion; idempotency_key and calling agent travel as MCP metadata.

transport.title: Authorize tool and execute compiled API operation
transport.inspect: Compare spec.method/path, allowed agent, body, status and response schema. Current catalogue tools target CARD_API_BASE_URL.

result.title: Validate result and resume actual execution
result.inspect: MCP structured result drives completion. Graph resumes only if a checkpoint is waiting. Operation success can still contain a business-failure Reply.

result.title: Validate reply and render
result.inspect: BFF exposes typed Reply/Operation. View actions supply Reply.data; write results usually provide a summary. Capture correlation headers.

journeys.title: Startup, catalogue discovery and approved-policy readiness
journeys.trigger: Launch the configured local or Docker stack after policy ingestion.
journeys.outcome: Agent starts only with usable approved policy index and matching MCP catalogue.

steps.title: Compose runtime dependencies
steps.inspect: Inspect AGENT_DB, model provider, remote FinCrime URL and checkpoint store.

steps.title: Build live RAG services
steps.inspect: Live runtime requires FastEmbed and remote persistent Qdrant unless an explicit test retriever is injected.

steps.title: Check approved documents and index compatibility
steps.inspect: POL-001 through POL-004 must exist. Verify approved version, content_hash and embedding_model.

steps.title: Read approved indexed evidence
steps.inspect: Read-only readiness queries; runtime startup does not ingest or initialize missing collections.

steps.title: Build supervisor and specialists
steps.inspect: Same retriever/evaluator instances are passed into supervisor. Check tool policies and checkpointer.

steps.title: Discover and verify tool schemas
steps.inspect: Gateway compares discovered tools with compiled OpenAPI/catalogue definitions.

steps.title: Recover accepted jobs
steps.inspect: Running operations were reset to pending at Journal construction; persisted delegation is revalidated before execution.

journeys.troubleshoot: For startup failure inspect service terminal, ingestion settings and index metadata. Compare catalogue/OpenAPI files on Agent and MCP; do not rebuild policy data during a request.

journeys.title: Register, password login and logout
journeys.trigger: Choose Register or Login, use the credential form, later Sign out.
journeys.outcome: Customer identity is stored by Cards; BFF rotates a cookie session and CSRF value.

steps.title: Send credential form
steps.inspect: Passwords go to /auth/register or /auth/password-login, not chat or MCP.

steps.title: Validate origin and throttle attempts
steps.inspect: Inspect origin and auth_attempts; repeated attempts produce 429.

steps.title: Authenticate Cards hop
steps.inspect: X-Banking-BFF selects the Experience-authorized banking entry path; downstream customer identity is not required for credential entry.

steps.title: Register or verify customer
steps.inspect: customers holds username and scrypt hash. Login compares hashes; registration username collision returns 409.

steps.title: Rotate and persist session
steps.inspect: sessions stores hashed session ids with expiry, claims and CSRF. Inspect existence/expiry, not a shared credential dump.

steps.title: Read session state
steps.inspect: React stores public name and CSRF. Login clears visible conversation state.

steps.title: End session when requested
steps.inspect: Logout checks CSRF, consumes stored session and clears cookie/UI state.

journeys.troubleshoot: 401: inspect customer hash verification and session expiry. 403: Origin/CSRF or service identity. Registration is outside Agent journal and does not have a conversation operation id.

journeys.title: Create account with optional first card
journeys.trigger: Choose Create account; select issue_card=true; review and confirm.
journeys.outcome: One account and optional card are durable; account and card commits are separate.

steps.title: Accept account creation
steps.inspect: POST /banking/accounts receives AccountCreate and the saved execution key.

steps.title: Create or replay account
steps.inspect: BEGIN IMMEDIATE protects customer/key lookup and account insert. accounts and banking_requests commit before optional issuance.

steps.title: Optionally issue first card
steps.inspect: Only if issue_card=true. Internal key is account: plus account execution key; store prefixes customer id.

steps.title: Replay or create card and snapshots
steps.inspect: Inspect card_issuance_requests, card_idempotency, cards and account_cards under one issuance transaction.

journeys.troubleshoot: Account exists but card is absent: retry the original account submission/key. Do not create another account to recover optional issuance. Use view actions to verify records.

journeys.title: View owned accounts and cards
journeys.trigger: Choose View my accounts or View my cards.
journeys.outcome: Owned lists return in Reply.data without write confirmation.

steps.title: Open read workflow and send empty inputs
steps.inspect: choose starts a conversation then posts inputs for view_* immediately.

steps.title: Refresh owned state and forward
steps.inspect: Reads still require an authenticated caller; local customer summaries are refreshed.

steps.title: Accept read operation and execute directly
steps.inspect: Catalogue confirmation=none skips nonce review; request still has durable operation status.

steps.title: Select customer-owned records
steps.inspect: GET /banking/accounts or /banking/cards filters by customer sub; cards reads join owned accounts.

journeys.troubleshoot: An empty list can be valid. Compare caller sub and effective native/Compose database. A BFF refresh failure may occur before the read operation is accepted.

journeys.title: Natural-language request, privacy and specialist routing
journeys.trigger: Send an authenticated chat message describing an account/card operation.
journeys.outcome: Sanitized interpretation returns a reply, private form or reviewed proposal; it does not directly authorize a write.

steps.title: Send message through authenticated BFF
steps.inspect: Frontend hides private-looking pasted input; server performs its own checks.

steps.title: Durably accept safe message
steps.inspect: submit replaces rejected private pastes before storage; message invalidates stale reviews.

steps.title: Analyze input and prepare model projection
steps.inspect: Inspect safe history/verified draft; raw account choices and credentials must not become model arguments.

steps.title: Load customer-scoped state and route
steps.inspect: thread_id=owner:cid. Inspect planned_intents, action_plan, permitted tools and policy decisions; supervisor can run repeatedly.

steps.title: Enrich facts and evaluate restricted intents
steps.inspect: Card lifecycle intents may invoke the RAG journey below. Account/auth/read intents do not need FinCrime facts.

steps.title: Propose Cards or FinCrime tool
steps.inspect: Specialists are permission-filtered. Deterministic stub/compound branches can bypass a provider call.

steps.title: Delegate FinCrime interpretation
steps.inspect: Only when remote specialist interpretation is actually invoked. A remote proposal is not an executed block.

steps.title: Interpret sanitized context
steps.inspect: Hosted and stub branches differ; inspect returned CustomerReply/ProposedToolCall and usage, not credentials.

steps.title: Resolve proposal and request review/details
steps.inspect: Missing owned account for issue_card opens create_account. A write waits for explicit review; follow that action journey next.

steps.title: Render proposal or private form
steps.inspect: input_tool selects the form; can_confirm/review controls confirmation.

journeys.troubleshoot: If forms work but chat fails, inspect PII, supervisor state, provider response and policy retrieval. Never infer write success from model prose alone.

journeys.title: Issue first, existing or additional card
journeys.trigger: Choose Issue new card and an owned account; explicitly select additional_card only for another card.
journeys.outcome: Ordinary issuance creates one card or returns already_exists; an explicit additional request can create another.

steps.title: Check blocked-card preflight
steps.inspect: Forms can reject a blocked account before confirmation; this is not the authoritative backend transaction.

steps.title: Revalidate before execution
steps.inspect: Inspect latest verified blocked-card facts, policy evidence and pinned versions. See runtime RAG journey.

steps.title: Authorize managed account and issue
steps.inspect: POST /banking/cards; backend still checks ownership and blocked-card restrictions.

steps.title: Check replay before existence and insert atomically
steps.inspect: BEGIN IMMEDIATE protects ownership, existing decisions, blocked cards and ordinary card existence. Same key/details replays; changed fingerprint conflicts.

steps.title: Propagate issuance decision
steps.inspect: Card-Issuance-Outcome/JSON outcome distinguishes created, already_exists and additional_created. HTTP 200 already_exists is not a failed creation.

journeys.troubleshoot: For a timeout, inspect saved execution key and card_issuance_requests before retrying. Keep the same key/body for one operation; a new additional card needs a new reviewed workflow.

journeys.title: Block or temporarily freeze a card
journeys.trigger: Choose Block card; select active card; enter a synthetic reason; review and confirm.
journeys.outcome: Cards status becomes blocked; a chat graph may offer a subsequent replacement.
notes: Current block/unblock catalogue entries have no idempotency_header. ToolSpec.safe_retry is false for these writes. Do not apply issuance retry guarantees to a block after an uncertain result.

steps.title: Evaluate block authorization and evidence
steps.inspect: POL-003/POL-004 evidence is required. A FinCrime specialist proposal is separate from API execution.

steps.title: Block the selected owned card
steps.inspect: Current tool resolves to POST /banking/cards/{card_id}/block on Cards, not POST /fincrime/cards/{card_id}/block.

steps.title: Persist blocked status
steps.inspect: cards.status becomes blocked. This route does not insert blocked_cards or persist reason in the separate FinCrime DB.

steps.title: Resume actual result and optional post-block offer
steps.inspect: When a waiting graph resumes, actual success creates card_blocked_success context. Offer logic considers the actual reason/context; a direct form may have no waiting graph.

journeys.troubleshoot: Inspect Cards status first. Missing FinCrime reason records can limit temporary-freeze/compromise classification; do not assume the two databases were synchronized by this tool.

journeys.title: Policy-driven unblock offer and subsequent issuance
journeys.trigger: With verified temporary-freeze facts, ask for another card; accept the unblock offer and confirm the reviewed unblock.
journeys.outcome: Eligible temporary freeze can be removed; a subsequent issue_card action requires its own review.

steps.title: Submit chat intent under the caller
steps.inspect: Use the chat path to observe the interactive policy branch. A private form can simply reject a blocked account.

steps.title: Resolve temporary-freeze evidence
steps.inspect: Facts must identify a temporary freeze and target card. See the MCP policy-facts journey; unknown reason is not automatically an eligible temporary freeze.

steps.title: Offer unblock or prohibit compromise
steps.inspect: Inspect pending_customer_question and pinned policy version. Permanently compromised facts prohibit unblocking.

steps.title: Accept policy question
steps.inspect: A conversational yes chooses the next intent; it does not replace the write confirmation nonce.

steps.title: Prepare selected unblock proposal
steps.inspect: Validate selected card binding and authorization. Remote interpretation is conditional; deterministic branches may prepare the proposal locally.

steps.title: Revalidate selected unblock
steps.inspect: Fail closed if policy retrieval/facts are unavailable or compromise forbids unblocking.

steps.title: Restore blocked card to created status
steps.inspect: Backend verifies ownership and current blocked state. This route does not update FinCrime records; compare sources if later policy facts remain blocked.

steps.title: Resume and review the next intent
steps.inspect: Inspect planned/completed intents and next proposal. Subsequent issuance requires a fresh review/confirmation, then follows issuance journey.

journeys.troubleshoot: No unblock offer: inspect reason provenance and temporary-freeze flags, not just Cards status. After unblocking, stale FinCrime block records can still influence remote facts. Block/unblock tool retries are not declared safe.

journeys.title: Replace a blocked card or run combined block-and-replace
journeys.trigger: Choose Replace card for a blocked card, or in chat explicitly request blocking and replacement of the same card.
journeys.outcome: Replacement card is created for the owned account while original remains blocked.

steps.title: Prepare standalone or compound intent
steps.inspect: Standalone form starts with a blocked card. Compound chat plan must order block before replacement.

steps.title: Collect selected card and build review
steps.inspect: For explicit block-and-replace, compound_approval binds both writes to the same selected card; review text explicitly authorizes replacement after blocking.

steps.title: Execute block first when combined
steps.inspect: Skip this phase for an already-blocked standalone replacement. Failure prevents replacement; uncertain block is not safely retryable by catalogue declaration.

steps.title: Resume block success and select replacement
steps.inspect: Combined approval may continue automatically for the same card. A block-only offer requires a separate customer decision/review.

steps.title: Persist and revalidate replacement
steps.inspect: Combined continuation resets submission, binds approved reason/card and saves before replacement. Latest successful block result can update stale signed summaries in this same request.

steps.title: Authorize blocked replacement target
steps.inspect: Target must exist, belong to customer and remain blocked. Replacement has its own durable key.

steps.title: Create or replay replacement snapshot
steps.inspect: cards gets new SIM card; account_cards links it. card_issuance_requests stores replacement_created; old card stays blocked.

journeys.troubleshoot: Inspect compound_approval.status (reviewed/confirmed/replacing/complete), block outcome and replacement key separately. This is ordered multi-step execution, not a transaction across both HTTP writes.

journeys.title: Approved policy ingestion and reindexing
journeys.trigger: Run python -m card_chat.policy.pipeline.cli ingest (or update FILE) with the runtime model/collection settings.
journeys.outcome: Approved Markdown is chunked, embedded and written to Qdrant with policy metadata and an ingestion audit entry.
notes: Ingestion is an operator journey, not a browser request: it has no browser cid/review/operation trace. Breakpoints require launching the CLI under a Python debugger.

steps.title: Select ingestion command and adapters
steps.inspect: Match POLICIES_DIR, QDRANT_URL, POLICY_COLLECTION, embedding provider/model with runtime. Use a configured shell or the Compose invocation in live-policy-runtime.md.

steps.title: Initialize collection using embedding dimension
steps.inspect: This is a separate ingestion process. Runtime startup does not create the collection.

steps.title: Read approved versions and metadata
steps.inspect: Approved flags/status, effective dates, version, required actions and content hash come from Markdown frontmatter/content.

steps.title: Validate and chunk document
steps.inspect: Inspect section chunks and metadata; empty documents produce no vectors.

steps.title: Embed policy chunks
steps.inspect: Each embedding input combines policy id/version, section title and content; dimensions must match collection.

steps.title: Replace policy points
steps.inspect: Inspect collection points and embedding_model/content_hash payload. Delete then upsert are separate operations, not one atomic cross-request replacement.

steps.title: Record ingestion and report collection
steps.inspect: POLICY_AUDIT_LOG defaults to data/policy_audit.json; it is distinct from Mongo request traces.

steps.title: Read and validate approved index
steps.inspect: Restart or recheck the live runtime with the new index. Existing workflows can reject changed pinned versions.

journeys.troubleshoot: If interrupted between delete and upsert, runtime can fail closed on missing/stale index; rerun approved ingestion. Check model/cache connectivity, writable audit path and identical ingestion/runtime config.

journeys.title: Runtime policy retrieval, verified facts and execution gate
journeys.trigger: Ask for a restricted card action in chat, or confirm an issue/block/unblock/replace proposal.
journeys.outcome: Approved evidence and verified domain facts produce a structured permit/deny/offer decision; unavailable evidence prevents restricted execution.
notes: This is policy-guided servicing, not an unrestricted document Q&A endpoint. A direct form may stop at blocked-card preflight before the full gate. No single action must touch every component; the journey set covers the distinct components.

steps.title: Start intent evaluation or confirmation gate
steps.inspect: Chat evaluates before delegation. Direct forms bypass language interpretation but restricted card actions revalidate at execution; create_account optional issuance is not in this restricted-tool list.

steps.title: Resolve selected account and signed summaries
steps.inspect: Inspect account_number resolution, caller accounts/cards, temporary_freeze, compromised and retrieval_failed.

steps.title: Read policy-facts for selected owned account
steps.inspect: This is read_resource, not call_tool. Customer delegation and tools permission constrain account and card ids.

steps.title: Enrich selected cards with block reasons
steps.inspect: MCP reads /fincrime/cards/{id} only for signed card summaries. A 404 preserves a signed blocked status without inventing reason/eligibility.

steps.title: Determine mandatory evidence and pins
steps.inspect: Runtime adapter is GroundedPolicyEvaluator, not legacy policy/evaluator.py. Required policy differs by intent; strict restricted checks also require POL-004.

steps.title: Verify active approved documents and index
steps.inspect: Check one approved version per id, matching content_hash/model metadata. Mandatory lookup cannot be omitted by semantic ranking.

steps.title: Embed safe query and perform semantic search
steps.inspect: Qdrant query_points returns hits filtered against current approved document/version/hash/model. Exact mandatory-index verification may also issue earlier embedding/search calls.

steps.title: Apply rule and interactive branch
steps.inspect: Inspect permitted/prohibited, required_actions, pending question, evidence_citations and pinned_versions. Semantic similarity is evidence retrieval, not ownership authorization.

steps.title: Persist decision and choose next step
steps.inspect: Thread owner:cid retains policy_evaluation, retrieved_policies and pins. Decisions can respond, hand off, request a choice or wait for confirmation.

steps.title: Enforce decision before mutation
steps.inspect: Denied gate returns a Reply without gateway write. Permitted reviewed actions continue through MCP tool and authoritative backend transaction.

journeys.troubleshoot: Inspect graph policy_error and raw caught exception in evaluator/retriever; check FinCrime reachability separately from Qdrant. PolicyRetrievalUnavailable is a safe customer-facing result, not the underlying cause. Changed pinned approved versions require a fresh workflow.

journeys.title: Asynchronous jobs, timeouts, replay and restart recovery
journeys.trigger: Select Submit and poll; interrupt a response or restart Agent after durable acceptance using synthetic data.
journeys.outcome: Accepted work is recoverable and retries preserve operation/execution identity according to tool guarantees.

steps.title: Submit with response preference
steps.inspect: Prefer: respond-async and browser Idempotency-Key are forwarded. Keep exact body/key for the same HTTP submission.

steps.title: Persist operation before 202
steps.inspect: operations stores owner,cid,kind,request_key,body,delegation,trace,status and request_hash. Changed key/body association returns 409.

steps.title: Restore authorization and execute handler
steps.inspect: Single worker lock serializes jobs. Saved delegation may expire; state and result commit together after handler completion.

steps.title: Poll caller-owned operation
steps.inspect: BFF rewrites status_url to /api/operations/{oid}. Poll trace differs from original operations.trace.

steps.title: Persist exact execution arguments/key
steps.inspect: For safely retryable tools, submission key survives failures/restart and is reused rather than regenerated.

steps.title: Return prior issuance decision without duplicate card
steps.inspect: Account/card/replacement replay behavior differs from block/unblock tools with no declared safe retry.

steps.title: Reschedule durable pending operations
steps.inspect: Journal resets running to pending at startup; recover schedules pending after gateway initialization.

steps.title: Inspect journal, graph and traces
steps.inspect: Use cid and request key to recover original execution trace. A succeeded handler may return a business error Reply.

journeys.troubleshoot: Do not delete snapshots or regenerate keys for an uncertain write. An existing completed browser operation returns stored result; retrying tool execution may require reconfirming the fixed reviewed action. An attempted unsafe tool must be checked before a new action.

journeys.title: Separate FinCrime API mutation and Cards synchronization
journeys.trigger: Invoke the configured FinCrime API with authorized service/customer headers, or debug its explicit integration tests.
journeys.outcome: FinCrime records block/audit state and attempts a separate Cards synchronization call.
notes: This integration path is documented separately because the current tools.json/OpenAPI routes all tool writes to Cards. It is not a required hidden phase of UI blocking.

steps.title: Authorize caller and accept block/unblock
steps.inspect: This is /fincrime/cards/{card_id}/block or /unblock, not the current UI catalogue target. Supply actual customer delegation; do not paste secrets into docs.

steps.title: Validate customer and reason restrictions
steps.inspect: With an injected Cards service, ownership/card details are checked in-process. Remote mode uses the code-specific boundaries; do not assume identical checks.

steps.title: Persist status, audit and optional retry snapshot
steps.inspect: Inspect blocked_cards, fincrime_audit_log and fincrime_idempotency. Account linkage depends on resolved/supplied account_number.

steps.title: Attempt status synchronization
steps.inspect: HTTP mode uses /banking/cards/{id}/block or /unblock with generated service headers; in-process mode calls BankingService directly.

steps.title: Check owner and update authoritative card status
steps.inspect: Verify actual Cards HTTP response and cards.status; FinCrime record commit and Cards update are separate effects.

steps.title: Return snapshot and sync indication
steps.inspect: Current service creates results with synced=True and only marks failure when both synchronization fails and result.synced is false. A failed remote sync can therefore leave synced=True; verify both stores directly.

steps.title: Expose block facts to trusted MCP reader
steps.inspect: Policy resource can consume stored reason/status; it does not retroactively make cross-service writes atomic.

journeys.troubleshoot: A successful FinCrime response or synced flag alone does not prove Cards changed. Inspect the synchronization call, service audience/client authorization and both SQLite stores. These observed implementation limits are not an automatic repair/reconciliation mechanism.

journeys.title: OIDC browser sign-in and destination-specific service identity
journeys.trigger: Choose OIDC sign in for the demo identity path, or inspect a protected BFF/Agent/MCP/Cards hop.
journeys.outcome: Browser identity establishes a BFF session; each service obtains a destination token and carries a separate customer assertion.

steps.title: Start authorization-code login
steps.inspect: GET /auth/login creates state, nonce and PKCE verifier; redirects browser to Identity. This is separate from local-customer password registration.

steps.title: Exchange authorization code and validate identity
steps.inspect: Check state cookie, one-use pending state, code_verifier, id-token audience/issuer and nonce.

steps.title: Persist session and sign customer assertion
steps.inspect: Inspect claims/account provenance. OIDC demo identities do not automatically create banking customers; account creation still checks customers table.

steps.title: Obtain destination service access token
steps.inspect: Client-credentials token is acquired per configured service; X-Customer-Delegation is separate from OAuth token and trace header.

steps.title: Verify token, service client and delegation
steps.inspect: Inspect audience, scope, azp, delegation sub/accounts/permissions and expiration. BFF banking entry has a special service boundary.

steps.title: Return correlation header and authorization result
steps.inspect: Protected services return X-Correlation-ID; Cards also returns X-Trace-ID. Record status and trace without copying tokens.

journeys.troubleshoot: 401 usually concerns invalid/expired token or assertion; 403 concerns service client/scope/account permissions. Check destination settings and signing-key consistency; do not assume a browser token can be reused at every API.

journeys.title: Follow a request into structured Mongo logs
journeys.trigger: Perform any journey with TELEMETRY_SINK=mongo and capture the main request correlation header.
journeys.outcome: Best-effort structured events and HTTP traces reach indexed Mongo collections independently of business commits.

steps.title: Establish downstream correlation context
steps.inspect: Main Agent forward has a fresh trace; each BFF account/card refresh has another. Existing operation trace identifies original execution, not later polls/replays.

steps.title: Record route status and duration
steps.inspect: Route templates, service, status_code, duration_ms and trace_id are emitted; not arbitrary request bodies.

steps.title: Select allowed application diagnostics
steps.inspect: Only tagged supported Agent/MCP events enter this sink; Cards emits domain events. Ordinary exception text remains in service terminals rather than structured Mongo export.

steps.title: Enqueue sanitized record without blocking business write
steps.inspect: Bounded queue uses put_nowait. Full queue emits console fallback; it does not roll back Cards state.

steps.title: Index and route records
steps.inspect: Thread creates seven-day timestamp TTL and trace_id indexes; kind=trace goes to request_traces, other events to application_logs in configured database.

steps.title: Find original operation trace and filter collections
steps.inspect: In Compass query trace_id in card_servicing.request_traces and application_logs. For outage read fallback console, original operations.trace and authoritative SQLite.

journeys.troubleshoot: Missing Mongo documents can mean sink=none/stdout, queue delay/full, credentials/connection failure or TTL expiry. These are operational logs, not a durable banking audit ledger. Do not infer commit outcome from log absence.
